description:
Commons gives you a free chat room for a group, where each member keeps using their own app: anything that can send a web request posts into it.

Commons has no upstream and no endpoint of its own: it is a free app built on UnitySVC rooms. Enrolling is what creates your room. The `free` channel asks you to approve one `resource:room` request, `create` with `kind=chat&max_members=100`, and the platform provisions a `chat` room that your account owns when the enrollment activates. The kind and the member cap are fixed by the request; you set the rest. A chat room keeps messages at most 7 days, or none if you choose: it is a catch-up buffer, and members' own apps keep whatever history they want. You invite people with invitation codes and assign their roles; read-only members only receive. Nothing is billed: the app and its rooms are free.

Enroll in Commons and approve the room request; the room then appears under **Rooms**, where you rename it, describe it, set its retention, create invitation codes and manage members. Anyone in the room posts from their own tool to the room webhook, `POST /v1/rooms/<API_KEY>/<room handle>` with a key that has `api:rooms` write (limit it to the room with `room=<id>`), or reads and posts in the Rooms page. See How to use this service for the steps.
